name: @qmulate/storage
description: Storage interface (put/get/presign/setRetention/delete with retention-refusal semantics), an in-memory adapter that contract-implements them, and the driver factory. The exit's 'retrievable' is proven against this CONTRACT via the in-memory adapter; the S3-compatible adapter and its object-lock proof are owed to the named gate before the first client migration (owner ruling 2026-09-01, option C — was 'the S3-compatible adapter is S10/E9', which the ruling re-dated).
